messages:
Maya Ortiz: Heads-up: the Python quickstart and the curl example are out of sync after the last SDK change. curl shows `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in the header, README python uses `os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY']` -> 401s when folks copy/paste.

Lucas Chen: Oof, that's confusing for new signups. I also noticed the Python snippet imports `aiohttp` but demonstrates a sync client call. Could trip people switching to async.

Nina Patel: I ran the repo quickstart verbatim and hit both issues. Also found a manual retry loop at the bottom of the example that causes double-retries now that the SDK has built-in backoff. Small PR incoming to fix parity and remove the manual retries.

Maya Ortiz: Nice. While you9re at it, please standardize on the env var name across all quickstarts and docs. Use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere and show how to set it for mac/linux and Windows.

Lucas Chen: Can we show both sync and async variants briefly? Lots of examples only show sync; customers ask about async parity in the SDKs.

Nina Patel: Plan: replace Python snippet with this sync-ready example and a one-line note about async: how to import AsyncRedwoodClient and await calls. Will also update curl to the same env var and add a token-scope callout. Snippet: 
```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate('Write a haiku about compilers')
print(resp.text)
```
And remove the manual retry block entirely. Add docs note: "Redwood SDKs perform automatic retries with exponential backoff by default. If you need to manage retries yourself, pass `retries=0` to the client constructor."

Maya Ortiz: Good call. Also add a short sentence on token scopes (generation vs embeddings) since we see permission errors from copying wrong scoped keys.

Nina Patel: Pushed PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/2799. Changes: env var parity (REDWOOD_API_KEY), swap to sync Python snippet, remove manual retry loop, add async note and token scope callout. Requesting docs review.

docs-bot: docs-bot: Label `DX` added, reviewers requested: @maya, @lucas.

Lucas Chen: Reviewed, left one wording nit on the retry sentence. Minor.

Maya Ortiz: Approved.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: docs site updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart 3 version 2026-03-22T16:00Z :rocket:

Nina Patel: Closing thread. Will scan other language quickstarts next week for similar drift. Thanks! :raised_hands:
